about_mission: ACS Mulinguae is committed to enabling individuals to communicate effectively and confidently across languages, equipping them to thrive in an increasingly interconnected world while safeguarding and advancing local and regional languages. We promote multilingualism not merely as a skill, but as a social and cultural framework capable of combating linguicide and linguicism. Our approach affirms the coexistence of international languages alongside local and regional languages, ensuring that linguistic diversity becomes a resource rather than a casualty of globalization. Our mission is also rooted in hope, equity, and achievement. We work to expand educational access and opportunity by delivering empowering and high-quality language programs to community leaders, workers, and learners of all ages who are committed to personal and collective advancement through education. Through this work, ACS Mulinguae fosters a dynamic community of language learners and strengthens cross-cultural understanding, cooperation, and social cohesion.
about_story: ACS Mulinguae is an academic initiative operating under the aegis of Asociación Ccahuac Solidarity (ACS), a non-profit organization established in 2010 in Lima, Peru. ACS was founded by a small collective committed to addressing the structural challenges of poverty and environmental degradation affecting vulnerable communities. Over the years, ACS has developed projects aimed at strengthening community resilience, including initiatives designed to promote food self-sufficiency, enhance awareness of global warming, and address the growing risks of food insecurity. These interventions are grounded in the conviction that sustainable development must be community-driven, ecologically responsible, and socially inclusive. Education has always been central to ACS’s mission. We consider it the primary instrument for long-term social transformation and empowerment. Within this broader framework, ACS Mulinguae advances educational initiatives that extend beyond local action to engage communities globally. Through its programs, it seeks to expand access to knowledge, foster intercultural dialogue, and contribute to sustainable human development across diverse contexts.
about_vision: We aspire to be a leading global provider of online multilingual education, empowering individuals and organizations to achieve their linguistic and educational objectives with confidence and excellence. We envision a world in which people communicate fluently across languages, dismantling cultural barriers and fostering mutual understanding, cooperation, and respect among diverse communities. Our mission is to make high-quality language education accessible to all—regardless of geography, socio-economic background, or prior educational opportunity—by leveraging technology to deliver innovative, inclusive, and learner-centered experiences. We recognize the profound diversity of learners and their cultural contexts. Accordingly, we embrace pedagogical approaches that are culturally responsive and rooted in local languages, traditions, and knowledge systems, ensuring that multilingualism becomes a bridge for empowerment rather than assimilation.
about_tutors: Our tutors are qualified and experienced education professionals who adhere strictly to the ethical principles articulated in the Teachers’ Charter and to the highest standards of professional conduct. The majority are bilingual or multilingual, reinforcing our institutional commitment to linguistic inclusion and intercultural competence. Continuous professional development is a core requirement within the organisation. Tutors engage in structured, ongoing training and lifelong learning, defined as the sustained, self-directed advancement of pedagogical knowledge, subject expertise, and instructional practice. This ensures alignment with evolving educational standards and the needs of diverse learner populations. Teachers constitute the operational and strategic backbone of the project. They play a leading role not only in programme delivery, but also in planning, monitoring, and implementation oversight, thereby ensuring quality assurance, accountability, and mission coherence at every level.
